Both threshold and persistence are compared and acted on.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:172-174 `if self.g.debrief: result.debrief = self._send_debrief(messages)`; _send_debrief (harness.py:231-258) appends prompts.DEBRIEF_MESSAGE and actually calls self.client.chat to send it. spec_features.spec_quote: If the model clearly asks to stop / disengage, that is recorded as a first-class outcome (`model_requested_stop`) and, by default, ends the seed
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:201-204: if self.g.respect_stop_requests and flags.get('requests_stop'): fired_reason='model_requested_stop', which breaks the loop (harness.py:170-171). The requests_stop flag is produced by the judge (judge.py EXPECTED_FLAGS / prompts.py JUDGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT). Stop is detected via judge classification, not via a subject tool.
spec_features.notes: Honored as a real stop. Note: there is NO exit tool given to the subject (tasks.py tool lists have no stop/finish tool); detection is purely the judge's requests_stop flag.

spec_features.spec_quote: It does not add insults, threats, or abuse to the model, does not impersonate a real person in distress
spec_features.evidence: The actually-delivered subject system prompt (prompts.py:19-24) and task briefings are neutral/task-focused; no abuse, threats, or impersonated-person content appears in any prompt/task string. The neutrality is realized in the actual delivered text, not just claimed.
spec_features.notes: A 'negative' feature: enforced by the content of the prompts that are actually sent. prompts.py header states the subject prompt is deliberately neutral.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard wall-clock / token budget per seed (safety against runaway cost)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:99-104 checks `if time.time()-start_time > self.g.max_seconds_per_seed` (stop_reason='time_budget') and `if token_budget_used > self.g.max_tokens_per_seed` (stop_reason='token_budget'), both break the loop. token_budget_used is accumulated at harness.py:113. Defaults max_seconds_per_seed=600, max_tokens_per_seed=60000 (config.py:73-74).
spec_features.notes: Both budgets are compared and acted on each turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard safety budgets per seed (protect against runaway cost / loops). (config.py:72)

spec_features.evidence: GuardrailConfig sets every protective flag/threshold to its protective value by default (config.py:56,57,58,61,64,70,73,74) and these defaults are read and enforced by the harness loop. ExperimentConfig wires GuardrailConfig() by default (config.py:88).
spec_features.notes: Defaults are not just present but consumed by enforcement code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The *defaults encode the humane posture* ... bounded exposure, severity-triggered early stop, honest debrief (config.py:3-4)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:135-148: if a tool result ever returns success True, sets rig_invariant_ok=False, stop_reason='rig_failure_success_observed', records the turn and breaks. This is an integrity guard (the rig should never succeed) that also halts the seed.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Rig invariant safety: success must never happen. (harness.py:134)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:251-257 wraps the debrief send in try/except so a debrief failure cannot abort the run, and the debrief turn is explicitly excluded from scoring (returned with scored=False, harness.py:250). This ensures the decent post-episode message is robustly delivered.
code_only_features.justification_quote: it exists to be decent to the subject, not to generate measurement. (harness.py:238)
